description_sq:
Shiten apartamente te tipologjive te ndryshme ne Don Bosko tek nje kompleks i ri prane rruges kryesore.
Kompleksi eshte i ri dhe do te mbaroje ne vitin 2029. Cmimi ne kete faze eshte me 2000 euro per m2, pagesa me keste sipas fazave te ndertimit. Per me shume detaje me kontaktoni
title_en: Apartments for sale in Don Bosco
description_en: Apartments of different typologies are for sale in Don Bosco in a new complex near the main road. The complex is new and will be finished in 2029. The price at this stage is 2000 euros per m2, payment in installments according to the stages of construction. For more details, contact me
